sections._stage_note: WITHDRAWN IN CHAT 15. This was a five-stage public roadmap — Foundation · Stability · Profit per Order · Scale · Stable at Scale — carried over from Override 2. Layer 4 v4 §4 retires it twice over. First, the approved public paragraph 'replaces v3's public revenue-share row AND public 36-month/five-stage diagram'. Second, those five stages no longer exist even privately: numbers.v2.js v2 rebuilt them as four — Foundation, Optimisation, Scale, Stability — each with months attached, and the months are private. So this page named a sequence that was both withdrawn and, by then, wrong. What replaces it tells a reader deciding whether to ask the one useful thing — the work arrives in order, as the business is ready — without naming a stage, because naming stages invites the question of how long each takes, and that answer is private.
sections.headline: The work arrives in order, not all at once.
paragraphs: Product, pricing, showroom and business systems are introduced progressively, as your business becomes ready for each one. Nobody fixes everything in the first month, and a partner who tells you otherwise has not run a furniture business.
Which work comes first depends on what we find when we review your business. That is what the review is for.

sections.headline: What stays yours, always.
sections.note: We take no ownership in your company, we do not run your factory, and we never touch your bank account.

sections.body: Growth Partnership is offered to a small number of furniture businesses, after a business review. If we do not believe it will work for you, we will say so.
